term.label: sequence_variant_causing_initiator_codon_change_in_transcript

definition.text: The DNA mutation changes, usually destroys, the first coding triplet of a gene. Usually prevents translation although another initiator codon may be used.

comments: OBSOLETE: This term was deleted as it conflated more than one term. The alteration is separate from the effect.

synonyms.value: sequence variant causing initiator codon change in transcript
mutation causing initiator codon change in transcript
